DIRECTION A · CINEMATIC  (my leading pick)
Dark film-poster feel in your existing navy + IMDb gold. Reads as a working screen actor — most industry-standard. Trade-off: leans on strong photography to sing.

DIRECTION B · EDITORIAL
Light magazine-profile look: serif headlines, generous white space, a press pull-quote. Refined and press-forward. Trade-off: quieter and more grown-up, less 'movie'.

DIRECTION C · KINETIC
Bold and young — oversized type, an electric accent, a credits marquee. Feels energetic and current. Trade-off: the loudest option; a strong look can date faster.

DIRECTION D · MARQUEE
Warm theatrical playbill in cream / oxblood / gold, nodding to the Nashville stage roots. Classic and elegant. Trade-off: reads more 'theatre' than 'screen'; most traditional.
